title: WEF SmartStart New York curriculum correction — depth 4
summary: New York is the strongest source-backed launch-geography lead; curriculum references include NASA, FIRST and Smithsonian Education.

data.question: What evidence resolves SmartStart geography and curriculum references?
data.method: Official transcript review and organization verification.
findings: Kiva Allgood says SmartStart is launching in New York.
More than 60 constituents co-developed the curriculum.
The curriculum examined NASA, FIRST Robotics and Smithsonian Education practices.
No partner school, district, contract or grant was identified.
NYSED Smart Start is an unrelated name collision.
conclusions: New York supersedes Michigan and Kentucky as the primary geography lead.
NASA, FIRST and Smithsonian are reference models, not established funders or operators.
recommendations: Identify the New York school, district, funding and vendors.
Preserve unrelated Smart Start false positives.
counterarguments: New York may refer to a programme office rather than the school's location.
limitations: The school and district remain undisclosed.

workflow.next_action: Identify the exact New York school, funding and vendors.
